inspiration.observed_pattern: A derived NATURAL LEFT JOIN must emit a NULL right-side value for a left row with no shared-column match.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reduced to two independently authored rows and one projected right-side value, retaining derived relations, implicit shared-column matching, and the NULL-extended unmatched row.

fixture_notes: Left row 701 matches right row 701 on both shared columns and returns amount 8; left row 702 has a same-ID right row with a different zone and must return NULL amount.
determinism_notes: Two fixed rows and explicit ID ordering isolate derived NATURAL LEFT JOIN null extension without clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent schedules.
setup: CREATE TABLE mini_left_stock (stock_id INT PRIMARY KEY, zone_code VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE mini_right_counts (stock_id INT PRIMARY KEY, zone_code VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL, amount INT NOT NULL)

steps.sql: SELECT left_stock.stock_id, left_stock.zone_code, right_counts.amount FROM (SELECT stock_id, zone_code FROM mini_left_stock) AS left_stock NATURAL LEFT JOIN (SELECT stock_id, zone_code, amount FROM mini_right_counts) AS right_counts ORDER BY left_stock.stock_id
